en.title: Work Schedules
en.description: Given the total weekly work hours, the daily limit, and a partially fixed seven-day schedule, list all valid schedules.
en.input: The input is work_hours, day_hours, pattern, separated by spaces; pattern has length 7, digits are fixed hours, and ? marks a day still to be scheduled.
en.output: Output a compact JSON array of strings, sorted in ascending lexicographic order.
en.explanation: Enumerate 0..day_hours for each question mark by position, pruning by the remaining hours and capacity.
hints: The daily limit is an input parameter and must not be treated as a fixed value.
